item.title: Iron Rich Foods for Kids, Pregnancy and the Rest of Us
item.description: Why Do We Need to Eat More Iron-Rich Foods? One of the more prevalent vitamin and mineral deficiencies in the US is low iron. If you’re low in iron, it can exacerbate fatigue, it can affect your cognition3 and in children, it is associated with poor cognitive development. 4You may not even know you’re low in iron!

item.description: Find out why all parents should be teaching their kids to cook.
